ITEM 1 | Bright red sliced strawberries, glossy moist surface with slightly paler red interior near cut edges, halved and quartered wedges with pointed tips, about 3 to 5 cm long per piece, scattered in the lower-left and center of the plate, slightly juicy | 60
ITEM 2 | Dark navy-blue small round berries, smooth glossy skin with a small crown at the top, about 1 to 1.5 cm diameter each, roughly 18 berries clustered on the left side of the plate beside the strawberries | 35
ITEM 3 | Bright red cubed and chunked fruit pieces with a moist, slightly translucent flesh, cut into irregular cubes and wedges about 2 to 4 cm, some with pale edges, arranged in a pile on the right side of the plate, juicy with a smooth surface and no browning or char | 210
